## 4. Base rates
- Muse has been No. 1 on most days since 2026-09-18, with at least one dip (reportedly No. 2 around 2026-10-06). I found no full daily record.
- Comparable cases:
  - 2025-10-03: OpenAI's Sora hit No. 1 in the US and held it for a few weeks before falling back. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2025/10/03/openais-sora-soars-to-no-1-on-the-u-s-app-store)
  - ChatGPT and DeepSeek both held No. 1 for long stretches during their surges.
  - Many AI apps have had explosive debuts and then faded. [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262178990-muse-app-tops-app-store-chatgpt-meta-ai-agent-downloads-tradingkey)
- The Top Free #1 spot is often taken for a day or two by promotions, such as restaurant giveaways or ticket and streaming events. Even a dominant app can lose any single-day snapshot to one.
